dct_title_s: Carbon Dioxide (Difference from Global Mean), OCO-3
dct_description_sm: The OCO-3 Carbon Dioxide (Difference from Global Mean) is a layer that combines OCO-3 XCO₂ (column-averaged dry-air mole fraction) and an estimated daily global trend XCO₂ value.

A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), covering 2019-08-06 to 2026-04-27. Made from OCO-3 Level 2 bias-corrected XCO2 and other select fields from the full-physics retrieval aggregated as daily files, Retrospective processing V11r (OCO3_L2_Lite_FP) (OCO3_L2_Lite_FP, version 11r, doi:10.5067/8U0VGVQC7HZG).
